title: Ὁ Φίλος καὶ Οἱ Γεωργοί
subtitle: Unit 2, Chapter 4 — The Friend and the Farmers

panels.scene: Wide landscape at dawn. The eastern horizon glows with the first golden light of sunrise. The last trace of the moon is pale and fading in the brightening sky. The field and house are visible below.
panels.greekCaption: πρωΐ ἐστιν. ἡ σελήνη οὐκέτι λάμπει. ὁ ἥλιος ἀνατέλλει.
panels.englishCaption: It is morning. The moon no longer shines. The sun rises.

captionTranslations.es: Es de mañana. La luna ya no brilla. El sol sale.
captionTranslations.pl: Jest ranek. Księżyc już nie świeci. Słońce wschodzi.
captionTranslations.fil: Umaga na. Hindi na sumisinag ang buwan. Sumisinag ang araw.

panels.scene: Interior of the house. A beam of morning light enters through the open door, falling across the room and onto the bed where the farmer lies.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ φῶς τοῦ ἡλίου ἔρχεται εἰς τὸν οἶκον.
panels.englishCaption: The light of the sun comes into the house.

captionTranslations.es: La luz del sol viene a la casa.
captionTranslations.pl: Światło słońca wchodzi do domu.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang liwanag ng araw ay pumapasok sa bahay.

panels.scene: The farmer sits up in bed, calm and rested, a hand on his chest. Morning light on his face. No fear — only peace.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς ἐγείρεται. οὐκ ἔχει φόβον. εἰρήνη ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer wakes. He has no fear. There is peace in his heart.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor se despierta. No tiene miedo. Hay paz en su corazón.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik budzi się. Nie ma strachu. W jego sercu jest pokój.
captionTranslations.fil: Gumising ang magsasaka. Wala siyang takot. May kapayapaan sa kanyang puso.

panels.scene: The farmer walks toward the river in the early light, carrying a cloth, moving purposefully toward the water.
panels.greekCaption: θέλει λούειν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ. πορεύεται πρὸς τὸν ποταμόν.
panels.englishCaption: He wants to wash his body. He goes toward the river.

captionTranslations.es: Quiere lavar su cuerpo. Va hacia el río.
captionTranslations.pl: Chce umyć swoje ciało. Idzie do rzeki.
captionTranslations.fil: Gusto niyang hugasan ang kanyang katawan. Pumunta siya sa ilog.

panels.scene: Close-up: the farmer crouched at the river's edge, cupping clear water in his hands. The water looks clean and inviting.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ ποταμοῦ καλόν ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: The water of the river is good.

captionTranslations.es: El agua del río es buena.
captionTranslations.pl: Woda rzeki jest dobra.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang tubig ng ilog ay mabuti.

panels.scene: The farmer, refreshed, walks back along the path from the river toward the house. Wet hair, clean face, light step.
panels.greekCaption: λούει τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ. πορεύεται πάλιν πρὸς τὸν οἶκον.
panels.englishCaption: He washes his body. He goes back toward the house.

captionTranslations.es: Lava su cuerpo. Regresa hacia la casa.
captionTranslations.pl: Myje swoje ciało. Wraca do domu.
captionTranslations.fil: Niligo niya ang kanyang katawan. Bumalik siya sa bahay.

panels.scene: The farmer stands facing the viewer, full figure, with the name Ἰάκωβος displayed beside him — the reveal of his name. Clear, warm, dignified.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ γεωργοῦ ἐστιν Ἰάκωβος.
panels.englishCaption: The name of the farmer is Jacob.

captionTranslations.es: El nombre del agricultor es Jacob.
captionTranslations.pl: Imię rolnika to Jakub.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang pangalan ng magsasaka ay Jacob.

panels.scene: A wider landscape of Galilean countryside: rolling green hills, small farms, the Sea of Galilee visible in the distance. Jacob small in the foreground, surveying his land.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος Γαλιλαῖός ἐστιν. κατοικεῖ ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob is a Galilean. He dwells in Galilee.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob es galileo. Vive en Galilea.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub jest Galilejczykiem. Mieszka w Galilei.
captionTranslations.fil: Si Jacob ay isang Galileo. Naninirahan siya sa Galilea.

panels.scene: Jacob standing at the edge of the field but turned away from it, looking toward the path. His tools are set down. He has decided not to work today.
panels.greekCaption: σήμερον οὐκ ἐργάζεται ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ.
panels.englishCaption: Today he does not work in the field.

captionTranslations.es: Hoy no trabaja en el campo.
captionTranslations.pl: Dziś nie pracuje w polu.
captionTranslations.fil: Ngayon hindi siya nagtatrabaho sa bukid.

panels.scene: A small Galilean village in the distance — clustered stone houses, a few trees, a dusty path leading to it. Jacob on the path, walking toward it.
panels.greekCaption: πορεύεται πρὸς τὴν κώμην.
panels.englishCaption: He goes toward the village.

captionTranslations.es: Va hacia el pueblo.
captionTranslations.pl: Idzie do wioski.
captionTranslations.fil: Pumunta siya sa nayon.

panels.scene: Jacob paused on the path, looking back at the field with concern. Then turning forward toward another farm nearby. Who will guard the field?
panels.greekCaption: τίς φυλάσσει τὸν ἀγρόν; πορεύεται πρὸς τὸν φίλον αὐτοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: Who guards the field? He goes to his friend.

captionTranslations.es: ¿Quién cuida el campo? Va a su amigo.
captionTranslations.pl: Kto strzeże pola? Idzie do swojego przyjaciela.
captionTranslations.fil: Sino ang nagbabantay ng bukid? Pumunta siya sa kanyang kaibigan.

panels.scene: Philip standing outside his own house, holding a farming tool, welcoming expression. His name Φίλιππος displayed beside him. His farm is near Jacob's.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ φίλου ἐστὶν Φίλιππος. πλησίον ἐστίν.
panels.englishCaption: The name of the friend is Philip. He is a neighbor.

captionTranslations.es: El nombre del amigo es Felipe. Es vecino.
captionTranslations.pl: Imię przyjaciela to Filip. Jest sąsiadem.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang pangalan ng kaibigan ay Felipe. Siya ay kapitbahay.

panels.scene: Jacob and Philip standing side by side, both in farmer's tunics, both holding tools. Equal in dignity.
panels.greekCaption: ἀμφότεροι εἰσιν γεωργοί.
panels.englishCaption: Both are farmers.

captionTranslations.es: Ambos son agricultores.
captionTranslations.pl: Obaj są rolnikami.
captionTranslations.fil: Kapwa silang magsasaka.

panels.scene: The two men in the ancient Middle-Eastern greeting: clasping hands and kissing on the cheek. Warm, genuine friendship.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος ἀσπάζεται τὸν Φίλιππον καὶ καταφιλεῖ αὐτόν.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob greets Philip and kisses him.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob saluda a Felipe y lo besa.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub pozdrawia Filipa i całuje go.
captionTranslations.fil: Binati ni Jacob si Felipe at hinalikan siya.

panels.scene: Jacob speaking to Philip, hand raised in greeting, mouth open mid-sentence. Philip listening and smiling.
panels.greekCaption: λέγει, "εἰρήνη σοι. πῶς ἔχεις σήμερον;"
panels.englishCaption: He says, "Peace to you. How are you today?"

captionTranslations.es: Dice: 'Paz a ti. ¿Cómo estás hoy?'
captionTranslations.pl: Mówi: «Pokój tobie. Jak się dziś masz?»
captionTranslations.fil: Sinabi niya: 'Kapayapaan sa iyo. Kumusta ka ngayon?'

panels.scene: Philip responding, one hand on his chest, smiling warmly.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Φίλιππος ἀποκρίνεται, "χαῖρε. καλῶς ἔχω."
panels.englishCaption: Philip answers, "Greetings. I am well."

captionTranslations.es: Felipe responde: 'Saludos. Estoy bien.'
captionTranslations.pl: Filip odpowiada: «Pozdrowienia. Mam się dobrze.»
captionTranslations.fil: Sumagot si Felipe: 'Kumusta. Mabuti naman ako.'

panels.scene: Philip's face showing friendly curiosity — eyebrow raised, head tilted.
panels.greekCaption: "διὰ τί ἔρχῃ ὧδε;"
panels.englishCaption: "Why do you come here?"

captionTranslations.es: '¿Por qué vienes aquí?'
captionTranslations.pl: «Dlaczego tu przychodzisz?»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Bakit ka pumunta dito?'

panels.scene: Jacob's face showing longing — looking into the distance toward the village, hand over his heart.
panels.greekCaption: "ἀγαπῶ τὸν οἶκόν μου. βούλομαι βλέπειν αὐτόν."
panels.englishCaption: "I love my house. I want to see it."

captionTranslations.es: 'Amo mi casa. Quiero verla.'
captionTranslations.pl: «Kocham mój dom. Chcę go zobaczyć.»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Mahal ko ang aking bahay. Gusto kong makita ito.'

panels.scene: Philip asking about Jacob's family. A soft inset shows a woman and children — the family Jacob misses.
panels.greekCaption: "ἆρα ἡ Μάρθα ἡ γυνή σου καλῶς ἔχει; καὶ τὰ τέκνα;"
panels.englishCaption: "Does Martha your wife fare well? And the children?"

captionTranslations.es: '¿Está bien Marta tu esposa? ¿Y los hijos?'
captionTranslations.pl: «Czy Marta, twoja żona, ma się dobrze? I dzieci?»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Mabuti ba si Marta na iyong asawa? At ang mga anak?'

panels.scene: Jacob's face showing worry — furrowed brow, looking back over his shoulder toward the field.
panels.greekCaption: "ναί, πάντες καλῶς ἔχουσιν. ἀλλὰ μεριμνῶ περὶ τοῦ ἀγροῦ."
panels.englishCaption: "Yes, they are all well — but I worry about the field."

captionTranslations.es: 'Sí, todos están bien, pero me preocupo por el campo.'
captionTranslations.pl: «Tak, wszyscy mają się dobrze, ale martwię się o pole.»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Oo, lahat ay mabuti — ngunit nag-aalala ako sa bukid.'

panels.scene: Philip stepping forward confidently, hand on Jacob's shoulder, reassuring expression. A stance of capability and willingness.
panels.greekCaption: "ἐγὼ πάρειμι. δύναμαι βοηθεῖν σοι."
panels.englishCaption: "I am here. I am able to help you."

captionTranslations.es: 'Estoy aquí. Puedo ayudarte.'
captionTranslations.pl: «Jestem tutaj. Mogę ci pomóc.»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Nandito ako. Kaya kong tulungan ka.'

panels.scene: Philip pointing firmly toward the village road, other hand raised in a reassuring gesture. Commanding but kind.
panels.greekCaption: "μὴ μεριμνᾷ. πορεύου πρὸς τὴν κώμην."
panels.englishCaption: "Do not worry. Go to the village."

captionTranslations.es: 'No te preocupes. Ve al pueblo.'
captionTranslations.pl: «Nie martw się. Idź do wioski.»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Huwag mag-alala. Pumunta sa nayon.'

panels.scene: Jacob clasping Philip's hand in both of his, looking him in the eyes. Deep gratitude.
panels.greekCaption: "ἀληθῶς φίλος ἀγαθὸς καὶ πιστὸς εἶ. ἀγαπῶ σε."
panels.englishCaption: "Truly you are a good and faithful friend. I love you."

captionTranslations.es: 'En verdad eres un amigo bueno y fiel. Te amo.'
captionTranslations.pl: «Prawdziwie jesteś dobrym i wiernym przyjacielem. Kocham cię.»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Tunay na ikaw ay isang mabuti at tapat na kaibigan. Mahal kita.'

panels.scene: Jacob turning away from Philip, hand raised in farewell, beginning to walk. Philip watching him go.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος ἀπέρχεται ἀπὸ τοῦ Φιλίππου.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob departs from Philip.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob parte de Felipe.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub odchodzi od Filipa.
captionTranslations.fil: Umalis si Jacob mula kay Felipe.

panels.scene: Jacob standing at the edge of his field, cupping his hand near his mouth, calling. The donkey visible in the field, head raised, ears perked.
panels.greekCaption: ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ καλεῖ τὸν ὄνον.
panels.englishCaption: In the field he calls the donkey.

captionTranslations.es: En el campo llama al asno.
captionTranslations.pl: W polu woła osła.
captionTranslations.fil: Sa bukid tinatawag niya ang asno.

panels.scene: Jacob and the donkey walking side by side on the road toward the village. Jacob's face relaxed, almost smiling. Morning light — a mood of lightness and anticipation.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος ἀπέρχεται μετὰ χαρᾶς καὶ εἰρήνης.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob departs with joy and peace.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob parte con alegría y paz.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub odchodzi z radością i pokojem.
captionTranslations.fil: Umalis si Jacob nang may kagalakan at kapayapaan.

panels.scene: A wider view from behind: Jacob and the donkey together on the dirt road, the village visible in the distance ahead, fields on either side.
panels.greekCaption: ἀμφότεροι πορεύονται ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ πρὸς τὴν κώμην.
panels.englishCaption: Both go on the road toward the village.

captionTranslations.es: Ambos van por el camino hacia el pueblo.
captionTranslations.pl: Obaj idą drogą ku wiosce.
captionTranslations.fil: Kapwa silang lumalakad sa daan patungo sa nayon.

panels.scene: Jacob walks with his staff carrying a bag of bread. The donkey carries fruit and vegetables from the field.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος περιπατεῖ μετὰ τῆς ῥάβδου καὶ φέρει τὴν πήραν. ὁ ὄνος φέρει καρποὺς καὶ λάχανα.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob walks with his staff and carries the bag. The donkey carries fruits and vegetables.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob camina con su vara y lleva la bolsa. El asno lleva frutas y verduras.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub idzie z laską i niesie torbę. Osioł niesie owoce i warzywa.
captionTranslations.fil: Lumalakad si Jacob kasama ang kanyang tungkod at dinadala ang bag. Dinadala ng asno ang mga bunga at gulay.

panels.scene: Farmers at work: some dig the ground and remove stones; others harvest fruit from the trees.
panels.greekCaption: οἱ μὲν σκάπτουσιν τὴν γῆν καὶ φέρουσιν τοὺς λίθους. ἄλλοι δὲ θερίζουσιν τοὺς καρπούς.
panels.englishCaption: Some dig the ground and carry the stones. Others harvest the fruits.

captionTranslations.es: Algunos cavan la tierra y cargan las piedras. Otros cosechan las frutas.
captionTranslations.pl: Jedni kopią ziemię i noszą kamienie. Inni zbierają owoce.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang iba ay humuhukay ng lupa at nagdadala ng mga bato. Ang iba naman ay nag-aani ng mga bunga.

panels.scene: Others sit under the trees in the shade to rest from the heat and talk about life.
panels.greekCaption: ἄλλοι καθίζουσιν ὑπὸ τοῖς δένδροις ἐν ταῖς σκίαις καὶ ἀναπαύονται.
panels.englishCaption: Others sit under the trees in the shade and rest.

captionTranslations.es: Otros se sientan bajo los árboles en la sombra y descansan.
captionTranslations.pl: Inni siedzą pod drzewami w cieniu i odpoczywają.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang iba naman ay nakaupo sa ilalim ng mga puno sa lilim at nagpapahinga.

panels.scene: Some farmers are rich with many servants; others are poor and work their own fields alone.
panels.greekCaption: οἱ μὲν πλούσιοί εἰσιν καὶ ἔχουσιν δούλους. οἱ δὲ πτωχοὶ ἐργάζονται ἐν τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀγροῖς.
panels.englishCaption: Some are rich and have servants. The poor work in their own fields.

captionTranslations.es: Algunos son ricos y tienen siervos. Los pobres trabajan en sus propios campos.
captionTranslations.pl: Niektórzy są bogaci i mają sługi. Biedni pracują na własnych polach.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang iba ay mayaman at may mga lingkod. Ang mga mahirap ay nagtatrabaho sa kanilang sariling mga bukid.

panels.scene: The sun beats down. Jacob is weary, hungry, and thirsty from the heat of the journey.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ἥλιος καυματίζει τὴν ὁδόν. κοπιᾷ ὁ Ἰάκωβος ἐν τῷ σώματι. πεινᾷ καὶ διψᾷ.
panels.englishCaption: The sun scorches the road. Jacob is weary in body. He is hungry and thirsty.

captionTranslations.es: El sol quema el camino. Jacob está cansado en su cuerpo. Tiene hambre y sed.
captionTranslations.pl: Słońce pali drogę. Jakub jest zmęczony w ciele. Jest głodny i spragniony.
captionTranslations.fil: Nagsusunog ang araw sa daan. Pagod si Jacob sa katawan. Nagugutom at nauuhaw siya.

panels.scene: Jacob finds a large tree near the road. Under it is a spring with clean water. The tree provides shade.
panels.greekCaption: εὑρίσκει δένδρον μέγα ἐγγὺς τῆς ὁδοῦ. ὑπὸ τῷ δένδρῳ ἐστὶν ἡ πηγή. καθαρὸν ὕδωρ ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ πηγῇ.
panels.englishCaption: He finds a large tree near the road. Under the tree is the spring. There is clean water in the spring.

captionTranslations.es: Encuentra un gran árbol cerca del camino. Bajo el árbol está el manantial. Hay agua limpia.
captionTranslations.pl: Znajduje wielkie drzewo blisko drogi. Pod drzewem jest źródło. Jest czysta woda.
captionTranslations.fil: Nahanap niya ang isang malaking puno malapit sa daan. Sa ilalim ng puno ay ang bukal. May malinis na tubig.

panels.scene: Jacob is thirsty but has no water jar to draw from the spring.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος διψᾷ ἀλλὰ οὐ δύναται ἀντλεῖν τὸ ὕδωρ ὅτι οὐκ ἔχει ὑδρίαν.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob is thirsty but cannot draw the water because he has no water jar.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob tiene sed pero no puede sacar el agua porque no tiene cántaro.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub jest spragniony, ale nie może czerpać wody, bo nie ma dzbana.
captionTranslations.fil: Nauuhaw si Jacob ngunit hindi niya makuha ang tubig dahil wala siyang tapayan.

subtitleTranslations.es: Unidad 2, Capítulo 4 — El Amigo y los Agricultores
